findings.summary: Glossary drift: every image 'remove' in this namespace is 'quitar' (attachments.remove_all 'Quitar imágenes', error_upload 'quítala', expired_staged 'Quítala', send_blocked 'Quita', error_quota 'quita'); 'eliminar' appears only here and in invitations.failed.gone, where a conversation is deleted. Removing an image from a message is not deleting it, so the notice should reuse the verb of the Remove action the person knows.
